commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Xeech-Leel secret order, as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are sickening; the Unbound drain sap, probably to make a draught to kill the Root guardian. The order wants the Eye of Argonia to heal the trees. 2. Find the dealer in Gideon market selling an Eye of Argonia, starting with Ovinius Calo (quest marker). 3. Talk to people, persuade them or pay a few coins; I can also examine the Eye (Glass) on display. 4. I do not know if the Eye on sale is real (the name Glass hints it is fake). I can find out by talking to Calo and examining it.

answer 1. The Eye on sale is cheap glass. Its old silver setting, which may hold clues, is kept by smugglers at Gideon South Watch. Unbound and a Collector (Imperial relic-hunter) have also asked about it. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, SE of the quay, and take the silver setting from the smugglers chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past, pick the chest lock, or get the key from the Smuggler Boss. 4. I do not know who the Collector is or why the setting matters; I could find out by asking around or examining the setting.

answer 1. I killed the smuggler boss, took the silver setting and found a note from Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, an Imperial relic-hunter after the Eye for twenty years. He says a ship name is scratched inside the band. 2. Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom by rootworm from Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight to Nesh-Deeka; I could also read the Collector note first, look for the ship, or seek the Collector. 4. I do not know which ship the name is, or what the Collector wants; I will read the note and ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. The Eye in Gideon was glass. Its setting names the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight (east coast south of Thorn) with a Gideon dealer stock aboard; the real Eye may have gone down with it. The Unbound also sought it. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold. 2. Nothing is set explicitly; presumably Nesh-Deeka will give the next lead to the wreck at Hatandros Bight. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka further, or go to the bay myself. 4. I do not know how she knows about the Unbound ("we listen"), nor how to reach or dive the wreck; I can ask her.

answer I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, working for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia on sale in Gideon (Ovinius Calo stall) was glass. I got Calo to talk by persuasion, killed the smuggler boss at Gideon South Watch (I had no lockpicks), took his key, and opened the chest for the Old Silver Setting and the Collector note. The Collector is Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter hunting the Eye for twenty years. Inside the band is scratched Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight (east coast south of Thorn) with a Gideon dealer whole stock aboard, so the real Eye may be in that wreck. Unbound were also in Gideon asking about it. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold (plus 200 earlier) and returned the setting, which I carry with the key and note. Next: find out how to reach the Pale Harvest wreck in Hatandros Bight, ahead of the Unbound and the Collector. I have no lockpicks.
